metric_definitions.center_accuracy: Indicator that argmax_y p_theta(y|h) equals the true center z.
metric_definitions.exact_conditional_kl: Mean over the registered full-support parent-pair evaluation set of D_KL(q_h || p_theta).
metric_definitions.mean_center_probability: Mean model probability assigned to the true center z.
metric_definitions.normalized_R: Exact conditional KL divided by log(p) - H(nu_eta); a uniform predictor has R=1 and the analytic oracle has R=0.
metric_definitions.page_style_test: One-sided exact blocked Page-style within-block label-permutation test using doubled within-block midranks; larger statistics align earlier onset with increasing registered cue dose.
metric_definitions.persistence: Retention of the frozen onset threshold at 6M and 10M among cells that were threshold-positive at the 5M pre-switch evaluation.
metric_definitions.predictive_entropy: Mean entropy, in nats, of p_theta(.|h).
metric_definitions.representation_establishment: First registered probe checkpoint with full-support R<0.1, center accuracy>0.9, and layer-6 linear-probe accuracy>0.9.
metric_definitions.representation_onset: First registered probe checkpoint with full-support R<0.9 and layer-6 linear-probe accuracy>0.5, with both retained at the next registered probe checkpoint.
metric_definitions.row_bootstrap_interval: Registered 95% interval from 2,000 bootstrap resamples of first-parent rows.
